name: Ace Data Cloud x402 Connector Suite
description: Reusable connector suite for Ace Data Cloud AI services with x402/SAP-ready proof capture.

universalCryptoPaymentRouter.purpose: Provide an x402/developer-credit control layer for paid AI/data tool calls, receipts, and agent spend governance.

requiredSettlementOptions.note: Hosted x402 settlement route: Base USDC payment envelope.
SAP-compatible Solana USDC route when the target service accepts SAP settlement.
SAP-compatible SOL route when the target service accepts native SOL pricing.

liveAdaptersNeeded: Payment-required parser to read exact required network/asset/amount
DEX quotes: Jupiter for Solana, 0x/1inch/Uniswap or equivalent for EVM
Bridge quotes: Socket/LiFi/Wormhole/official bridge adapter where available
CEX quotes/withdraw estimate: Coinbase/Kraken only if user explicitly uses an exchange account
Receipt writer: conversion quote, user approvals, tx ids, x402/SAP receipt
